scope: V14 remote evidence candidate versus v13, unchanged costs/value weights/hysteresis. 32 directed cases, two regression runs, 24 held-out finished matches over four correlated worlds. Defaults unchanged; not a whole-bot equal-CPU-budget claim.

projection.retained: Every case, command, outcome, visit, frozen prediction attempt, accepted switch source report, unknown count, work audit, timing and artifact hash. Omitted duplicate counters/unchosen examples/raw flag certificates remain bound by raw hashes.
projection.added: landing_site_joins binds native capture telemetry with the same destination and exact physical landed_tick to the accepted switch candidate site. Missing telemetry is unknown; agreement alone does not certify matching geometry or route.
